blocking_failure.assessment: RETRACTED: not an upstream defect. Pixal3D CODE was run against the microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B CHECKPOINT. TencentARC/Pixal3D weights were never downloaded. Pixal3D's ss_flow_img_dit_1_3B_64_bf16.json declares image_attn_mode='proj' and accepts a projected conditioning dict; the TRELLIS.2-4B config omits image_attn_mode (defaults to 'cross') and expects a tensor, so manual_cast(cond, dtype) received a dict.
